summary: This Form 6-K filed by Spotify Technology S.A. is a routine earnings release for Q1 2026, reporting financial results and key performance indicators such as MAUs, subscribers, revenue, and margins. It does not involve any special situation like an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. The filing is purely an update on quarterly performance with no transactional or corporate governance event described.
